calls.head: Special teams tilt toward Edmonton
calls.body: Edmonton ranks 1st of 32 on the power play (9.7 expected goals per 60); Seattle ranks 29th on the penalty kill.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 1 games this season
calls.happened: Edmonton’s power play created 6.2 expected goals per 60 in 5:06 of 5-on-4 time, against its usual 9.7, and scored 0 goals.

calls.head: Seattle pounces on mistakes, and Edmonton makes them
calls.body: Seattle ranks 10th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.5% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Edmonton ranks 29th for avoiding breakdowns.

EDM.head: We gave Edmonton a 70% chance, and Edmonton delivered.

SEA.head: We gave Seattle only a 30% chance, and it went the way we feared.

surprises.head: Edmonton controlled the chances
surprises.body: Expected goals ran 3.5 to 1.7 for Edmonton, with empty nets left out.

surprises.head: Seattle tried a different line
surprises.body: J. McCann, K. Kakko, M. Beniers played 9:26 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Seattle’s usual lines.
